description: This file defines a serializer class ByteStringCodec for the ByteString type, implementing reading and writing logic for serialization within the Orleans framework using Protobuf wire protocol.

classes.name: ByteStringCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for ByteString, providing serialization and deserialization methods.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a ByteString value from the reader, handling reference and length-prefixed wire types.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a ByteString value to the writer, including handling of references and length-prefixed wire type.
